rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"high","title":"MsgPack014 nullable formatter check inverted, unrelated to requirement","detail":"The requirement does not ask for this change. The MsgPack014 query now collects IMessagePackFormatter<T> interfaces whose reference-type argument is Annotated (T?) instead of NotAnnotated (T). As a result, formatters that already implement IMessagePackFormatter<T?> get the warning 'Implement IMessagePackFormatter<T?> (with nullable annotation)'. Formatters that lack the annotation, which are the ones the diagnostic exists for, are no longer flagged. Every correctly written formatter in user code would raise a false warning, which breaks builds that treat warnings as errors. Existing MsgPack014 tests would also fail, and no test change covers this.","hunkIds":["h3"],"citations":[{"file":"src/MessagePack.SourceGenerator/Analyzers/MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer.cs","side":"new","startLine":372,"endLine":378,"quote":"iface.TypeArguments is [INamedTypeSymbol { IsReferenceType: true, NullableAnnotation: NullableAnnotation.Annotated } a]"},{"file":"src/MessagePack.SourceGenerator/Analyzers/MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer.cs","side":"new","startLine":287,"endLine":294,"quote":"messageFormat: \"Implement IMessagePackFormatter<{0}?> (with nullable annotation)\","}]},{"kind":"defect","severity":"medium","title":"Report filter also drops diagnostics with no location","detail":"ReportIfLocatedInCompilation forwards a diagnostic only when Location.IsInSource is true. A diagnostic created with a null location (Location.None) is therefore dropped as well, even when the problem is in the compiling project. Location.None is allowed for analyzers; only locations in syntax trees outside the compilation are not. Several TypeCollector diagnostics get their location from helpers that can return null, such as GetIdentifierLocation, GetParameterListLocation, identifier?.GetLocation() for MemberNeedsKey, and FirstOrDefault()?.GetSyntax(). Before this change, those diagnostics were still reported without a location. Now they are discarded. The generator path never reports diagnostics, so the user gets no message at all, and GetObjectInfo may return null and leave the type without a formatter. This is the silent failure N1 rules out.
